children.text:
A V-steam, vaginal steam, or Choa-yok as it’s known in Korea, is an ancient natural healing technique used in Korea and has its roots in many ancient cultures around the world. It’s still widely used today by women for its many health benefits.

 

Though this practice started thousands of years ago, you may have only heard about V-steaming recently in health blogs, articles, and magazines as its health benefits have become known to the broader community. 

As more and more women turn to alternative healing for solutions to their feminine health issues, vaginal steaming is becoming ever-more popular, and for good reason, as it offers nourishment and healing for many ailments.

At King Spa, we offer guided, traditional V-Steam treatments in a comfortable spa setting.

children.text:
A V-Steam treatment involves a woman undressing and sitting on an open-seated chair while medicinal herb-infused steam gently permeates her vagina and reproductive organs.

 

The herbs used in a V-Steam treatment at King Spa include:

– Wormwood (antimicrobial and antiviral)

– Rutin (anti-inflammatory)

– Mugwort (antibiotic; balances female hormones)

– Dandelion (treats infections and inflammation)

Each herb is carefully selected for its health properties in relation to a woman’s vaginal and reproductive well-being. 

A treatment at King Spa will typically last 40 minutes. During this time, we will make sure you are comfortable and will keep you hydrated. You will also be provided with a large covering to ensure your privacy and to contain the steam.

children.text:
Vaginal steaming boasts a variety of health benefits for women and is used in the treatment of many diseases and ailments that impact women’s reproductive organs. Some of the benefits of V-Steam include:

Boosts blood circulation + oxygen levels: V-Steam treatments enhance blood circulation and increase oxygen levels in the pelvic region, promoting overall vitality and optimal function of reproductive organs.

Tones, cleanses, and nourishes the uterus and cervix: V-Steam helps to tone the uterine and cervical muscles, while also cleansing and nourishing these organs. This promotes their overall health and function.

Increases fertility: V-Steam creates an environment conducive to conception by optimizing the condition of the reproductive organs and enhancing the chances of successful fertilization.

Promotes menstrual health: V-Steam treatments support menstrual health by reducing discomfort, relieving cramps, and improving overall well-being during menstruation.

Reduces pain from menstruation: V-Steam treatments can alleviate menstrual pain by relaxing the pelvic muscles, reducing inflammation, and improving blood flow to the reproductive organs.

Regulates the menstrual cycle: V-Steam can help regulate the menstrual cycle by balancing hormonal levels and promoting a consistent and predictable pattern of menstruation.

Removes stagnant energy and blockages: V-Steam treatments help to remove stagnant energy and blockages in the reproductive system, allowing for improved energy flow and enhancing overall reproductive well-being.

Aids in post-partum rejuvenation: V-Steam treatments assist in post-partum recovery by promoting healing, toning the uterus, and supporting the restoration of the reproductive system after childbirth.

Revitalizes and moisturizes vaginal tissue: V-Steam treatments rejuvenate and moisturize the vaginal tissue, promoting elasticity, reducing dryness, and enhancing overall comfort and health.

Naturally detoxes the female sex organs: V-Steam treatments naturally detoxify the female sex organs by assisting in the elimination of toxins, bacteria, and impurities, promoting a clean and healthy reproductive environment.

children.text:
V-steaming is a safe, gentle, and non-invasive natural healing practice used by many women to increase the vitality of their pelvic area, vagina, and reproductive organs like the uterus and ovaries. While there are no known health risks to V-steaming, there are certain times when women should avoid doing them, including:
  • If you are pregnant or think you could be
  • If you have an IUD
  • If you have an active infection or a herpes outbreak
  • If you are ovulating and attempting to get pregnant
  • If you are currently menstruating
  • If you have just given birth
  • If you are recovering from an injury or surgery in the region

At King Spa, we offer you the chance to receive a V-Steam in a relaxing, resort-style spa atmosphere where everything will be prepared for you. All you have to do is sit and relax. We’ll take care of the rest. You can book a V-Steam appointment in the women’s locker room when you come into the spa. Our guides will provide you with the necessary information and attire. We’re dedicated to your relaxation and well-being. Come in for your V-Steam treatment today!

Purchase your Day Pass here and book a V-Steam treatment when you come in.
